d:
Hal hi men kangres adhyaksh mallikarjun kharge ne ek karyakram ke dauran piem narendr modi ke pita se jura ek bayan diya. is par bijepi ne kari aapatti jataee.
Bite kuchh salon men aise kaee bayan dekhne ko mile hain. kya inka chunavon par asar hota hai aur ye taza bayan kitni dur tak jaega? bibisi ke karyakram dinbhar men varishth patrakar sanjiv shrivastav se bibisi ke mohanlal sharma ne yahi samajhne ki koshish ki.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
